technical.summary: Short-term bullish momentum with breakout confirmation, but overbought conditions and price below 200-day MA limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 52 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signals from junior members 85-90 days ago combined with extreme market fear (30/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and small transaction sizes limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (306.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 52 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + DC20 new high + AO cross-up confirm short-term momentum breakout in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 256.96.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below both 200-EMA and 50-SMA with stoch/stochRSI overbought, inverted yield curve recession signal, earnings event risk in 52 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create a momentum trap in severe macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (three white soldiers, DC20 new high) offers short-term breakout confirmation in extreme fear environment, but this is offset by severe macro headwinds and lack of fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve recession signal combined with earnings event risk in 52 days creates event-driven downside trap; overbought stoch/stochRSI conditions suggest momentum exhaustion despite breakout appearance.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 4 other IT holdings in 25-position portfolio creates sector concentration risk; skip entry to avoid compounding exposure in high-volatility tech during macro stress.
